fieldValues.title: A meeting's kind sets its agenda
fieldValues.decision_question: Should every meeting take the same agenda, or should a meeting's kind decide what it handles?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-15, in a clerked session; proposed in clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md). The owner instructed: record and hold.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A meeting's kind sets its agenda: decision, affirmation review, unblock, intake triage or retrospective.
fieldValues.rationale: Different questions need different meetings; when every kind of question arrives in one stream the owner loses the thread. The desk already serves as the unblock list.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a meeting is held that fits no kind.
